summary.name: Figma
summary.one_liner: Figma is a collaborative, browser-based design canvas where teams and AI agents work together on interface design, prototyping, design systems, and handoff to development.
use_cases: iterating on feedback with an AI agent
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Figma as an AI-native canvas where teammates and AI agents share context to generate, refine, and align on ideas. Its built-in agent can add motion to designs, document design systems, and implement feedback. The page says teams can take work from work-in-progress to shipped product in one workspace. It mentions dev tools and technical design controls for precision, and says design context, codebase, and agents stay connected so designs match what ships. A listing says it is a collaborative interface design tool for vector graphics and UI prototyping. The page also claims 95% of the Fortune 500 uses Figma, based on March 2025 data.
notable: AI agent shared with teammates in the same design canvas
Connects design context and codebase so designs stay consistent with what ships
Built-in dev tools for handoff to production
caveats: Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page; the freemium label comes from an external listing
Platform list is not explicitly stated on the page beyond the web app; a macOS freeware listing is cited externally
